01_bm25.text: Refurbished Samsung Galaxy S10E. I use this refurbished Samsung Galaxy S10E for routine daily use and it works as good as new. Thank you Amazon.

Renewed Factory Unlocked S10e Review. The Renewed Factory Unlocked Samsung Galaxy S10e looks like the best bang for the buck right now (6/2020), since everyone is eyeing the more expensive S20 models. Try to get a Factory Unlocked version, not just a Carrier Unlocked version. So what does "fully unlocked" in the product description really mean? I got a Carrier-unlocked T-Mobile phone (for the S10e, model numbers end with TMB) from vendor Synergy, not a Samsung factory unlocked phone (for the S10e, model numbers end with XAA), if that matters to you. Got to wonder how long T-Mobile will support this phone with software updates compared to Samsung. And be aware of the terms used on these Amazon pages, like Renewed, Used-Good, Used-VeryGood, etc. If something is less expensive, it might be in poorer condition.

💙 Beautiful camera. I've used Samsung Galaxy S10e for about 5 months and I'm very happy with it. I upgraded from Galaxy 7 edge to S10E and noticed a big difference. I wanted to get an iphone X, but after trying it out, I noticed that S10E has a better camera and beautiful filters.
Samsung Galaxy S10E 128GB. I love everything about it

Locked phone! Not new and I can not use it!. Bought this Samsung Galaxy S10e new from Chubbietech. The description and pictures stated new factory unlocked phone. The 2 that I recieved both had sprint SIM cards in them and are locked from sprint. They advised I return the phone because it can not he used with any other carrier at this time. I have requested a fix for the issue at hand. I will update my review if this is resolved rather quickly.
Samsung galaxy s10e. The phone is giving me problems and people can't hear me on it
Samsung Galaxy S10e, 128GB. As advertised. Works fine.
The most important is I'm satisfied and with my phone. Very good I recommend this phone samsung Galaxy s10e

Great phone @ price point. This Galaxy S10e will need a case. I got an otterbox defender for about 35$, mainly because the 1st day i got my S10e it slipped out of my hand because it is very small & the back left hand corner has been cracked because the backs of the s10e are also glass. (This S10e is alot smaller than my old StraightTalk Samsung Galaxy J3 @walmart). The S10e's performance is much better than I thought especially for its size
s10e Galaxy phone. Like the Samsung S10e for the size and features of finge3r recognition. Best price was on Amazon Prime and I got it in 2 days when I needed to replace my broken phone.

Item NOT what was in description. The described item was a Samsung Galaxy s10e unlocked. The item that I received was a Samsung Galaxy s10. Not to mention I went to add it to my account and it was still under another person's name so I was unable to use it and had to return.
Not Unlocked. This is for the Samsung Galaxy S10E that is advertised as unlocked. It is not an unlocked phone. Phone is locked to Verizon.
-Very good value for the money. The Galaxy S10e is the best compromise for my uses between all 3 S10 (S10, S10+ and S10e).

Thought these were locked to Verizon but figured it out.. Bought three Samsung Galaxy s10e phones and they all work great with our Mint Mobile service. I originally thought two of them were locked to Verizon but all I had to do was change a network setting from Global to LTE/4G/3G/2G.

Great phone!. I have a Samsung Galaxy S10e myself and needed to get my mother a new phone (she still had a flip phone). I found the S10e on Amazon that is renewed and factory unlocked. It was in excellent condition and works perfectly. We took it to our AT&T store and got a new SIM card and we were up and running. This phone is easier for her to use because I put all the items she will use on the home screen so she doesn't have to hunt through menus like she did on her flip phone. I have had Samsung Galaxy phones for years now and love them!
samsung galaxy s10e appears to be a lightly used renewed phone. great deal. not used yet.. phone looks new and appears to be a great deal. haven't activated it yet.

Great product and service. My Samsung galaxy s10e came in the condition as advertised and shipping came in earlier than expected. The phone was advertised as in very good condition and meets that criteria. And, most important of all, the phone was factory reset and I was able to work with my network provider to activate my phone easily.
Great renewed Samsung Galaxy S10e. I am very pleased. It works very well. The price wasn't bad at all and much more affordable than a brand new phone.
Galaxy S10e. Great phone
Like a new condition. I bought samsung galaxy s10e 256GB from Chubbiestech. It is like a new condition and good battery life.

02_dense.text: Actually unlocked - works well with obscure carriers!. After 6 months of spinning my wheels with pseudo-unlocked Galaxy s10e's from sellers like CellTrader (protip-they misrepresent their phones!), it is so nice to finally get a phone that isn't full of carrier bloat ware, and also automatically downloads APN settings from my carrier!

i was lucky. I was worried from the 1 star reviews but was lucky, my samsung 9s+ had no issues transferring data over to the samsung 10e. I used mint mobile as my network and had no issues with connectivity or service.

Thought these were locked to Verizon but figured it out.. Bought three Samsung Galaxy s10e phones and they all work great with our Mint Mobile service. I originally thought two of them were locked to Verizon but all I had to do was change a network setting from Global to LTE/4G/3G/2G.

Reliable Budget Friendly GSM Mobile Phone. The Samsung S10e is a reliable budget friendly GSM phone that fits perfectly into the palm of your hand. It is not a large phone. The device itself is very user friendly, works well for average daily use (calls, browse and texts) and is best suited for any person looking for a small device with basic user friendly features. It takes good pictures, calls are clear and buttons function smoothly. Works great for a child, can be used as a backup phone (Unlocked GSM - most US Carriers), short-term trips, vacation purposes, etc. ... and most importantly the cost won't break the bank. Should you decide on choosing, it may be advisable to pickup a compatible case. It will provide added protection in the event of accidents. I give it four (4/5) stars because it's a basic model phone - not mind blowing.

Amazon’s error in this Samsung S10E phone transaction. I bought a Samsung S10E handphone for my godson. When he put in his SIM card, it did not work. Some sort of error message: Invalid SIM card. Network locked. SIM card inserted. Seller listed as Lifeline 786, fulfilled by Amazon. I wrote to Amazon about this problem, and awaiting their remedial action, lest I ask for a full refund if the phone cannot work in Singapore. -Mr Stephen Lee.

Love my new Galaxy S10e. Very happy with my new Galaxy S10e. It worked well out of the box. T-Mobile easily transferred my info from my S6. It operates exactly as expected, and is easy to use. The battery life is great.15 hours off the charger and I’m at 61%.

The seller was Chubbiestech and my phone came factory unlocked to my relief. I do think it's important to check who the seller is specifically. All that aside, the phone works great! I love the smaller size of the Galaxy s10e compared the the s10 or s10+. All the cameras take fantastic pictures. As always, Samsung killed it.

Did Not connect on my provider.... The s10e phone looked great and most functions worked like new. But I returned mine because it was extremely slow on my Tmobile network. But my s7 connected faster. And it would NOT connect to the internet at all.

Galaxy s10. Phone does exactly what it's supposed to. Open to any carrier. Only complaint is that the battery doesn't seem to last as long as my brand new s10 did before this but I habe chargers everywhere so no big deal.

No worries!. I purchased a GSM Galaxy S10e with 256GB of on board storage here and could not be happier. The phone came exactly as I ordered and it showed virtually no signs of use while saving me 50% off the cost of a new phone. They have a very happy customer in me now.
Refurbished Samsung Galaxy S10E. I use this refurbished Samsung Galaxy S10E for routine daily use and it works as good as new. Thank you Amazon.

This phone WILL NOT work on the AT&T Network. I was so happy with the phone. It arrived quicker than promised. It was in excellent condition. It was packaged professionally. THEN... After 4 lengthy calls with AT&T, I called the Seller, GizmoTrader. The Customer Service Rep was extremely nice but he confirmed this phone WILL NOT work on the AT&T Network in February after they delete the 3G service. The Samsung S10e Model # G970F is not included on AT&T's list of phones that will work. There are other S10e Model #'s that will work but this one will not.

This may become obsolete in the US. I am very happy with the performance and capabilities of the Samsung S10E. Just the right size and a fantastic camera, especially in low light (I could capture planets and even took a picture of the very faint NEOWISE comet!). However, I have seen articles recently that imply without the capability of Voice over LTE (VoLTE), the voice functions may stop working in the future on AT&T and T-Mobile networks. I am concerned.

Certified Gadgets are the best to buy from. I purchased a Samsung Galaxy S10e renewed from Certified Gadgets on Oct. 2019. It worked perfectly until the Samsung April 7th update. I lost my call-waiting. I had Verizon service and call-waiting was part of the package. But the "Supplementary Service" icon was gone after the update. I spent hours/days with Verizon, Samsung and Assurion warranty. Everyone pointed the finger to the other companies. No one knew how to fix it or honor a replacement. I went to UBreakIFix and they couldn't fix it either. I changed provider to Cricket and still no Call-Waiting. So... I called Certified Gadgets upset. He calmed me down and explained how to solve the problem. I didn't believe him. He mailed me an AT&T SIM card and YES! it worked! My Supplementary Service is back up and running!
S 10 refurbished phone. S 10 worked perfectly. Was comfortable with my T Mobile. When needed will buy from this seller agin.

Not worth it. The LTE/WIFI signal drops randomly when in use only way to get it back is to turn on & off airplane mode. It still shows I'm connected to WiFi/LTE but nothing loads. None of my friends have issues with the same carrier I got or the wifi... This is the second S10e phone with this issue. NOT WORTH IT.
Samsung Galaxy S10e, 128GB. As advertised. Works fine.

Good as new. The refurbished Samsung Galaxy 10e was carefully packaged, arrived promptly, and I set it up with ease. As I have not used either the fingerprint reader or face recognition, I cannot rate them.

AT&T uses GSM and Verizon uses CDMA so I thought the incompatibility verdict seemed reasonable. In working with the carriers CS agent, he had me go into settings>connections>mobile networks>network mode. There you will see a list with one of the choices checked indicating the setting the phone is on. He told me to select "Global" . When I told him there was no "Global" or "LTE/CDMA" selection, he said the phone was not compatible. Picture 1 is my old S6, which I am replacing, and Picture 2 is the S10e. The CS agent also had me go into the Access Point Names. There was no access point listed, just some text saying "not available to this user" or something similar.

04_strip_model.text: No longer works on network. Bought to replace old phone in August 2021. Everything said it would work on network when they shut down 3G. Come February 2022, carrier says no longer works on network and have to buy a new phone to keep account. I seriously think something should be done about these false advertisers ripping people off.

They combine reviews the actual review for the 256 GB blue phone that you see in the picture is what I am writing right now. That phone is not unlocked it is tied to Sprint it is not Samsung unlocked Samson did not unlock this phone. This is carrier unlocked. So it will not connect to any carrier you want only certain carriers such as Verizon T-Mobile and Sprint and possibly AT&T. I have a prepaid which is called Visible wireless and that will not connect. I have other unlock phones that will work with Visible no problem. This phone has a Sprint rom Meaning by default it is always trying to connect to the sprint network. You can choose another net work manually, but certain carriers will not connect such as visible wireless. I should mention LTE does connect through Visible wireless.

Great phone. The functionality of the phone is fantastic, but the phone needs some tweaking by the seller and your carrier to work on your carriers network (in my case Straight Talk). Getting this phone setup for network and calling was a bit of a pain, but we'll worth the savings of a brand new phone.

I say "go for it!" Just make sure you select the correct options of either unlocked or a specific carrier. I chose T-Mobile, but I received an unlocked version, which is fine, because it's working well. I am texting and making phone calls without an issue. Best!
Only works on Wi-Fi —won’t connect to carrier. Phone only works with Wi-Fi- will not connect to carrier so it cannot be used.

Phone was advertised as Unlocked, but was sent a phone still locked to T-Mobile. I guess it's a good thing that's the carrier I needed. Phone is in excellent used condition- which is the reason for the 3 stars. But now I'm out the money I spent on this phone if I ever want to switch carriers. Super deceptive practices, and from the hundreds of reviews saying the same thing, I can see I'm not alone.

AT&T uses GSM and Verizon uses CDMA so I thought the incompatibility verdict seemed reasonable. In working with the carriers CS agent, he had me go into settings>connections>mobile networks>network mode. There you will see a list with one of the choices checked indicating the setting the phone is on. He told me to select "Global" . When I told him there was no "Global" or "LTE/CDMA" selection, he said the phone was not compatible. Picture 1 is my old S6, which I am replacing, and Picture 2 is the S10e. The CS agent also had me go into the Access Point Names. There was no access point listed, just some text saying "not available to this user" or something similar.

I've had a difficult time. For me personally, I've had many issues activating with gsm carriers. It definitely is unlocked. As all of these services say my imei is clean. However I think there is an issue with the device because anytime I put in a sim card. Doesn't matter if it's activated in store or not. It comes up with network errors. I'd love to get a replacement and use this device because I'm plenty happy with the product I've gotten from the seller. It just doesn't connect to mobile networks. Which is a stressor on my work. If possible I'd love to update this posting when I can get an available replacement or refund. Again. Not an issue with the seller. I just believe this device has a fault in it. I messaged the seller and we're currently in communication about how to best solve this problem. To sum it up.

Phone was blocked. after reading some of the comments before buying I was a little worried. I got the phone it looked great but when I swapped SIM cards it couldn't register on a network and I had T-Mobile. I took it there to see if they could do it. They read the numbers that identified that phone and put it into their system. Turns out the phone was blocked by a carrier. The refund was fast.

When you sell an item make sure everything works before you send it to the customer.. I love the phone! But i couldn't get a sim for it. You need to know before you buy which network your phone will work on. My carrier said this was compatible with my network, but it wasn't. It was a great phone! I would highly suggest this seller! The phone was near perfect and not a scratch!

Unlocked Phone didn't work on AT&T Network. I was under the impression that an unlocked phone worked on any mobile carrier network. I was wrong. Phone didn't connect with my existing Sim card. I called At&t and was on the phone with customer service for an hour and was told that I needed a new Sim card. I went to the At&t store and was provided with a new Sim card. This didn't work either. So after wasting a week waiting for the phone and hours to set it up, ultimately I had to return it. Then I had to wait another week for another phone that did work right out of the box. I also haven't been issued a refund for the item even though it was returned to them (I checked the return and it made it) almost a week ago.

works on verizon, imei is compatible with GSM networks too. :). Got this today. was skeptical after reading previous reviews as i have verizon. Had no issues at all. I looked up the imei at cricket and it is compatible too. recommend so far.
Comments misleading. Not really sure because the phone was not compatible with my carrier, even though in the comments section it said it was

Not a scam. Perfectly functional in great shape.. I'm starting to believe people just like to complain. Most complaints I see are people saying "its not unlocked" well the description says VERIZON. So that may be a hint. Number 2. Did you take time to click the "Unlocked" option? No didn't think so. Second its refurbished. Its not always going to be PERFECT and new. Although the one I got is. Even had a nice glass screen protector. Mine is Verizon and connected to the network no issue. Judging by the OR sticker on back these were sold to ECOATM or similar. They check to make sure not stolen, and if you notice the seller says 90 refund or exchange if something is wrong. So stop complaining unless you're really scammed, you weren't.

Not a scam. Perfectly functional in great shape.. I'm starting to believe people just like to complain. Most complaints I see are people saying "its not unlocked" well the description says VERIZON. So that may be a hint. Number 2. Did you take time to click the "Unlocked" option? No didn't think so. Second its refurbished. Its not always going to be PERFECT and new. Although the one I got is. Even had a nice glass screen protector. Mine is Verizon and connected to the network no issue. Judging by the OR sticker on back these were sold to ECOATM or similar. 06_rerank.text: They combine reviews the actual review for the 256 GB blue phone that you see in the picture is what I am writing right now. That phone is not unlocked it is tied to Sprint it is not Samsung unlocked Samson did not unlock this phone. This is carrier unlocked. So it will not connect to any carrier you want only certain carriers such as Verizon T-Mobile and Sprint and possibly AT&T. I have a prepaid which is called Visible wireless and that will not connect. I have other unlock phones that will work with Visible no problem. This phone has a Sprint rom Meaning by default it is always trying to connect to the sprint network. You can choose another net work manually, but certain carriers will not connect such as visible wireless. I should mention LTE does connect through Visible wireless.

No longer works on network. Bought to replace old phone in August 2021. Everything said it would work on network when they shut down 3G. Come February 2022, carrier says no longer works on network and have to buy a new phone to keep account. I seriously think something should be done about these false advertisers ripping people off.

Actually unlocked - works well with obscure carriers!. After 6 months of spinning my wheels with pseudo-unlocked Galaxy s10e's from sellers like CellTrader (protip-they misrepresent their phones!), it is so nice to finally get a phone that isn't full of carrier bloat ware, and also automatically downloads APN settings from my carrier!

AT&T uses GSM and Verizon uses CDMA so I thought the incompatibility verdict seemed reasonable. In working with the carriers CS agent, he had me go into settings>connections>mobile networks>network mode. There you will see a list with one of the choices checked indicating the setting the phone is on. He told me to select "Global" . When I told him there was no "Global" or "LTE/CDMA" selection, he said the phone was not compatible. Picture 1 is my old S6, which I am replacing, and Picture 2 is the S10e. The CS agent also had me go into the Access Point Names. There was no access point listed, just some text saying "not available to this user" or something similar.

Great phone. The functionality of the phone is fantastic, but the phone needs some tweaking by the seller and your carrier to work on your carriers network (in my case Straight Talk). Getting this phone setup for network and calling was a bit of a pain, but we'll worth the savings of a brand new phone.

I was nervous. I was nervous to order a refurb phone and some of the other reviews said their phone didn't work with their carrier, but I needed a new phone and this was a budget-friendly option. I'm so glad that I went for it. The phone arrived and it looked brand new, no scratches or dings. I popped my sim card in (t-mobile) and it worked perfect. If you're looking for a galaxy series phone without the hefty cost, definitely consider buying one of these! Just make sure it will work with your carrier first.

Phone was advertised as Unlocked, but was sent a phone still locked to T-Mobile. I guess it's a good thing that's the carrier I needed. Phone is in excellent used condition- which is the reason for the 3 stars. But now I'm out the money I spent on this phone if I ever want to switch carriers. Super deceptive practices, and from the hundreds of reviews saying the same thing, I can see I'm not alone.

When you sell an item make sure everything works before you send it to the customer.. I love the phone! But i couldn't get a sim for it. You need to know before you buy which network your phone will work on. My carrier said this was compatible with my network, but it wasn't. It was a great phone! I would highly suggest this seller! The phone was near perfect and not a scratch!

Unlocked Phone didn't work on AT&T Network. I was under the impression that an unlocked phone worked on any mobile carrier network. I was wrong. Phone didn't connect with my existing Sim card. I called At&t and was on the phone with customer service for an hour and was told that I needed a new Sim card. I went to the At&t store and was provided with a new Sim card. This didn't work either. So after wasting a week waiting for the phone and hours to set it up, ultimately I had to return it. Then I had to wait another week for another phone that did work right out of the box. I also haven't been issued a refund for the item even though it was returned to them (I checked the return and it made it) almost a week ago.

I say "go for it!" Just make sure you select the correct options of either unlocked or a specific carrier. I chose T-Mobile, but I received an unlocked version, which is fine, because it's working well. I am texting and making phone calls without an issue. Best!

I've had a difficult time. For me personally, I've had many issues activating with gsm carriers. It definitely is unlocked. As all of these services say my imei is clean. However I think there is an issue with the device because anytime I put in a sim card. Doesn't matter if it's activated in store or not. It comes up with network errors. I'd love to get a replacement and use this device because I'm plenty happy with the product I've gotten from the seller. It just doesn't connect to mobile networks. Which is a stressor on my work. If possible I'd love to update this posting when I can get an available replacement or refund. Again. Not an issue with the seller. I just believe this device has a fault in it. I messaged the seller and we're currently in communication about how to best solve this problem. To sum it up.

Great Condition, Unlocked Phone, very Responsive Seller. I was skeptical at first after reading the reviews. Once I received the phone it had no cracks or scratches and powered on with a little less than half the battery power. I did have difficulty connecting to my carriers network and thought perhaps it may not be unlocked. I reached out to the seller who was very responsive. Almost instantly they replied to every message. They told me what needed to be done to activate the device and it actually worked. I'm very satisfied with this purchase!
